structure_policy_rationale: Original 图标本身已经是高度抽象的几何符号（三个互锁圆环），符合 theme_design_analysis 中‘当 Original 是清晰几何符号时保留主体轮廓’的规则。不需要像游戏图标那样重构语义，只需将原本的渐变色块转化为红蓝黄配色的粗描边手绘色块即可。
preserve: 三个圆环相互扣连的拓扑结构
整体呈三角形/云朵状的轮廓布局
中心镂空与圆环交叠的空间关系
上一下二的品字形排列骨架
must_preserve: 三个圆环的基本位置关系（上一下二）
圆环之间的穿插遮挡逻辑
recompose_allowed: 圆环的粗细比例（加粗以适应手绘风）
具体的颜色分配（映射到主题红蓝黄板）
边缘的平滑度（变为抖动的手绘线条）
restyle: 去除所有科技渐变和光影
应用粗糙的黑色马克笔手绘描边
填充高饱和度纯色块（砖红、深蓝、奶黄）
模拟蜡笔或粉笔的哑光颗粒质感
forbid: 禁止保留原本的蓝粉渐变色
禁止使用细线条或无描边设计
禁止将三个环拆解或改变其互锁关系
禁止添加任何立体高光或阴影
禁止使用绿色、紫色等非主题色
generation_brief: Retro hand-drawn doodle icon of Baidu Netdisk. Three interlocking rings forming a cloud-like triangle shape (top one, bottom two) on pure black background. Thick, rough, uneven black marker outlines. Solid flat fills: Deep Blue, Brick Red, and Creamy Yellow. No gradients, no shadows, no gloss. Naive, clumsy, crayon texture aesthetic.
color_application: Map original blue/cyan gradient to theme's Deep Blue and Brick Red/Creamy Yellow. Assign distinct solid colors to the three rings (e.g., top ring Blue, bottom-left Red, bottom-right Yellow) to maintain contrast and hierarchy without using gradients.
stroke_application: Replace original smooth vector edges with thick, irregular, hand-drawn black strokes. Ensure lines have visible jitter and varying thickness to simulate marker pen pressure.
composition_application: Center the three-ring structure. Scale to occupy 60-70% of the canvas. Maintain the triangular balance but allow for slight asymmetry in the hand-drawn execution.
identity_application: Strictly preserve the 'three interlocking rings' topology. The identity relies on the specific way the rings overlap and form a cloud/triangle shape. Do not simplify into separate circles; the connection is key.
fidelity_constraints: Must have thick, rough hand-drawn black outlines
Colors must be solid blocks from the Red/Blue/Yellow palette
No gradients, shadows, or 3D effects allowed
Subject must look like a naive crayon/marker drawing
negative_constraints: No fine lines or clean vector aesthetics
No complex details or text labels
